text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text:
Man, the Satsuki Sho was awesome!
Getting a good spot early was totally worth it.

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
"Right? The lineup was great too,
especially Sirius Symboli!
I felt this raw, natural talent from her...!"

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text:
According to rumors, she used to be Symboli Rudolf's
training partner back in the day.
Supposedly, she was the only Umamusume who could keep up with her.

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
"You're running in the next Derby too, right?!
I can't wait!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Sirius Symboli showcased her powerful running
in the Satsuki Sho and moved smoothly forward."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...! Haah, haah!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—Phew!
Alright, show me the time, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Mm, not bad.
Still, considering the distance is gonna increase, it's not good enough yet.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
The uphill track is a given, but
we need additional stamina training on top of that.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Trainer, pick out some endurance training before tomorrow's session.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Alright.
We'll take a break, then do one more run on the slope.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Ever since hearing about her past, I had speculated
that she might be harboring a touch of loneliness
toward Symboli Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Ever since then, I've been secretly keeping an eye on her just in case, but—
choice_data_list: (For now, I'm moving forward with my eyes firmly ahead.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps I was overthinking things a little after all.
She's simply indignant at the change, just as she said—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Wanting to outshine her accomplishments" might really mean nothing more than the literal words themselves.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "...Come to think of it, it's quite a villainous motivation."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet if that anger has been sublimated
into the driving force propelling her through the race, then so be it.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
“—Someday, I will stand atop this world
and shine brilliantly.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There should be no issue with fuel,
even if it lacks beauty.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...At any rate, next is the Japanese Derby.
I want to keep moving forward without letting my guard down!
